camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise UpdateInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceSource ECS_OWN --InstanceId 1260000 --Port 3306 --DatabasePassword 000000 --Host '192.XXX.0.56' --ExportTimeout 600 --EnvType product --DbaId 270000 --InstanceAlias instance_test --DatabaseUser dbuser --InstanceType mysql --QueryTimeout 60 --SafeRuleId 30000
description_en: Updates the information about a database instance and checks the connectivity of the database instance
description_zh: 更新实例信息，同时检查该实例连通性
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise update-instance --instance-type mysql --instance-source ECS_OWN --env-type product --host 192.XXX.0.56 --port 3306 --database-user dbuser --database-password 000000 --instance-alias instance_test --dba-id 270000 --safe-rule-id 30000 --query-timeout 60 --export-timeout 600 --instance-id 1260000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The type of the database. For more information about the valid values of this parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据库类型，取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the database instance. Valid values:

PUBLIC_OWN: a self-managed database instance that is deployed on the Internet
RDS: an ApsaraDB RDS instance
ECS_OWN: a self-managed database that is deployed on an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance
VPC_IDC: a self-managed database instance that is deployed in a data center connected over a virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例来源，取值如下：
PUBLIC_OWN：代表公网自建实例
RDS：代表RDS实例
ECS_OWN：代表ECS自建实例
VPC_IDC：代表VPC IDC自建实例
parameters.name: instance_source

parameters.help_en:
The type of the environment in which the database instance is deployed. Valid values:

product: production environment
dev: development environment
pre: pre-release environment
test: test environment
sit: system integration testing (SIT) environment
uat: user acceptance testing (UAT) environment
pet: stress testing environment
stag: staging environment
parameters.help_zh:
环境类型，取值如下：
product：生产环境
dev：开发环境
pre：预发环境
test：测试环境
sit：SIT环境
uat：UAT环境
pet：压测环境
stag：STAG环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ECS instance on which the database instance is deployed.

This parameter is required if the InstanceSource parameter is set to ECS_OWN
parameters.help_zh:
ECS的实例ID。

如果InstanceSource取值为ECS_OWN，此值必填
parameters.name: ecs_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC to which the database instance belongs.

This parameter is required if the InstanceSource parameter is set to VPC_IDC
parameters.help_zh:
实例VPC ID。

如果InstanceSource取值为VPC_IDC时，此值必填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region in which the database instance resides.

This parameter is required if InstanceSource is set to RDS, ECS_OWN, and VPC_IDC
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在地域。

如果InstanceSource取值为RDS、ECS_OWN或VPC_IDC，此值必填
parameters.name: ecs_region

parameters.help_en: The host address that is used to connect to the database instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例连接地址
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The port that is used to connect to the database instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例访问端口
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The system ID (SID) of the database instance.

This parameter is required if the InstanceType parameter is set to ORACLE
parameters.help_zh:
实例Sid。

如果InstanceType为ORACLE，此项必填
parameters.name: sid

parameters.help_en: The account that is used to log on to the database
parameters.help_zh: 数据库账号
parameters.name: database_user

parameters.help_en: The password that is used to log on to the database
parameters.help_zh: 数据库访问密码
parameters.name: database_password

parameters.help_en: The alias of the database instance. Specify an alias that can help you identify the database instance in DMS
parameters.help_zh: 实例别名，帮助用户快速区分定位该实例
parameters.name: instance_alias

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who assumes the database administrator (DBA) role of the database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to query the user ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例DBA角色的用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dba_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the security rule set (GroupName) for the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/417891.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to query the name of the security rule set
parameters.help_zh: 实例的安全规则集（GroupName），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/417891.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: safe_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for querying data in the database instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例查询超时时间
parameters.name: query_timeout

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for exporting data from the database instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例导出超时时间
parameters.name: export_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database link for cross-database queries.



This parameter is required if UseDsql is set to 1.

The name can contain only lowercase letters and underscores (_).

The name must be unique within a tenant
parameters.help_zh:
输入跨库查询datalink名称。

如果UseDsql取值为1，此值必填。
DBLink名称只能使用小写字母和下划线（_）。
DBLink名称需要在租户内保持全局唯一性
parameters.name: data_link_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the lock-free schema change feature for the database instance. Valid values:

0: disables the lock-free schema change feature.
1: uses the online DDL of MySQL first.
2: uses the lock-free schema change feature of DMS first
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否开启无锁结构变更，取值如下：

0 ：不使用
1 ：原生无锁优先，失败转DMS执行
2 ：DMS无锁变更执行
parameters.name: ddl_online

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the cross-database query feature for the database instance. Valid values:

0: disables the cross-database query feature.
1: enables the cross-database query feature.

Supported database types: MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle), and ApsaraDB for Redis
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用跨实例查询，取值如下：
0：不开启
1：开启

支持的数据库类型：MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、Redis
parameters.name: use_dsql

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip the connectivity test. Valid values:

true: skips the connectivity test
false: does not skip the connectivity test
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否忽略测试连通性。取值如下：
true：忽略
false：不忽略
parameters.name: skip_test

parameters.help_en:
Y: enables the sensitive data protection feature
N: disables the sensitive data protection feature
NULL or other: does not update the status of the sensitive data protection feature
parameters.help_zh:
Y：开启敏感数据保护
N：关闭敏感数据保护
NULL或其它：不更新敏感数据保护的状态，即保持原始的开启或关闭状态
parameters.name: enable_sell_sitd

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classification template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html operation to query the template ID
parameters.help_zh: 更新分类分级模板ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the classification template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html operation to query the template type
parameters.help_zh: 更新分类分级模板类型。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: template_type

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
